title: Endings
info: An ending closes the problem from the middle.
It can be happy, calm, or surprising, but the reader should know the story is finished.

options: starts a new story and stops mid-sentence
finishes the problem the story raised

questions.q: They found the cat under the bed, safe. is

options: in the middle of the problem

questions.q: Stopping before anyone deals with the problem
You can hint the feeling at the end, such as
options: Nila smiled and shut the gate
a new character with no name who vanishes

questions.q: Type the story part that comes last.
